description: Watches the ARP/neighbor table for new hardware on the LAN and for a known address answering from different hardware.
name: wire_arrivals

signals.description: A MAC address not seen before appeared in the ARP/neighbor table.
signals.name: new_neighbor

signals.description: A known IP address now answers from a different MAC address -- the classic ARP-spoofing tell.
signals.name: mac_moved
